scope: PostgreSQL persistence and recovery evidence for the V2 Basis → RiskBudgetReservation → Receipt → Order → Ledger chain. Authorization and execution facts remain append-only and are joined by plan, basis and reservation identities.

tests.quality_gate: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache make check — 553 contract, 9 property, 2 schema, 1 unit passed; ruff, mypy, secret scan and health passed

verified_behaviors: authorization, reservation, receipt, order and ledger facts commit together
a rejected stage rolls back every earlier fact in the caller transaction
restarting with a fresh connection returns the committed order/ledger projection
repeating the same plan is idempotent
acceptance: The durable cross-context transaction slice is verified; V2-001 remains IN_PROGRESS because its broader contract ownership and independent Exit review are still open.
